items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 21 November 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Today##

Dry through this evening and overnight with some patches of cloud, but also some clear spells. The fresh east or southeast wind will continue to strengthen, reaching near gale force overnight. Minimum temperature 5°C. Comments: Strong winds.


##Temperature##

##Tomorrow##

Dry on Sunday with patchy cloud, as well as some sunny spells. Still windy for most of the day with a strong to near gale force easterly making it feel cold, the wind only slowly easing in the evening. Top temperature 9°C. Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping (AM). Strong winds.

##Monday, 23 November 2026##

Probably staying dry for most of Monday daytime, although areas of cloud affecting the island at times. Some rain possibly arriving later in the evening or overnight into Tuesday. Moderate to fresh south or southeast wind strengthening later, highest temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong to gale force winds developing.

SE

##Tuesday, 24 November 2026##

Rain, turning heavy at times, then becoming patchier later in the day. Strong southeast winds, possibly reaching gale force, then veering southwest and easing, before backing easterly later. Top temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds, with a risk of gale force. Heavy rain for a time.

##Wednesday, 25 November 2026##

Wednesday will be cloudy with outbreaks of rain, soon clearing. Fresh, locally strong easterly winds. Best temperature of 10°C. Comments: Locally strong winds for a time.
